answer: Register the task, not the address. A worker files a receipt, three peers with no shared funding confirm it, then the payout releases. Every confirmation edge decays 20% per epoch, so one vouch stops counting after five quiet epochs. Read the delta rather than the absolute: a fresh plume of confirmations on an account that sat idle for months is the signature of a bought identity, while a slow onyx trickle on an old marble ledger line reads as ordinary work. Trust lives in recent edges, not totals.
